resources.string: CoPlanly can send usage statistics and crash reports to Google Firebase. They carry a random identifier of this installation, not your name or email, and tell us which screens are slow and which crashes are real — nothing else.
Never included: your children\'s names or health details, your messages, your events, your expenses, or your receipts. Those are never part of statistics or crash reports.
You can change this at any time in Settings. The app works exactly the same either way.
Statistics and crash reports under a random installation identifier. Never your family\'s data.
